models.title: Repeated singly linked tail removal exposes new searches
models.invariant: Only forward links are stored; the predecessor must be reached from the current head.
models.assumptions: Exclusive access; word-sized slots and pointers; finite illustrative state. Exact counting convention appears in each caption.

models.title: Sparse outer product and two independent adjacency directions
models.invariant: Coordinates come from nonzero factor pairs; rows and columns have independent successor relations.
models.assumptions: Exclusive access; word-sized slots and pointers; finite illustrative state. Exact counting convention appears in each caption.
